headline: Grind City gets the Tony Hawk camera
lede: Grinds, manuals and grabs now hard-cut to a low fisheye action cam, and every finished run plays back a ten-second replay — re-skated from your own inputs, not recorded pixels.

notes.text: GRIND CITY cameras: chase, fisheye action cam (grinds/manuals/air grabs) and a dedicated replay cam, joined by hard cuts with a white flash and FOV punch; landings yank the camera.
Run replay re-simulates your last 10 seconds from the same seed with the logged input words — byte-identical to the live line (proved hash-per-tick), slow-mo on airs, Space/tap to skip.

grindcheck grew a replay-determinism proof and a third mutant (a lying input log) — 27/27 green, 3/3 mutants caught; gcdrive now proves the replay screen and the action-cam cut-in in real Chrome (11/11).
